author: Jana Dunow
text: Great company and super friendly! They were late due to an issue at the appointment before ours, but they called and kept us informed when they were on their way. They answered any questions we had and did a great job. Definitely recommend East Mountain Pumping & Septic Services!

author: Shawn Capehart
text: The company was very professional, stayed in constant contact, and was quick and thorough. They even taught me about my septic system, showing me the condition, and answered all my questions. I will definitely use them next time without hesitation!

author: cameron weimorts
text: I can not express how happy and grateful I am for this company. They went above and beyond to help my disabled veteran father. Although they where booked up for this evening she pointed me towards cnm pumping and my goodness what an experience highly recommend them both. I will definitely be using both of them again in the future. God bless you and your company.  🙏

author: Michelle Simmons
text:
It was very easy to schedule an appointment. The person I talked to was extremely nice and polite.
Josh Jordan, the owner came out to drain the septic tank, very nice gentleman, easy to talk to.
I highly recommend East Mountain Pumping. Would definitely use them again!

author: Diana Boyd
text: Excellent communication. They are friendly and very professional. Josh was able to educate us on all matters regarding our septic. We felt good about our care of our system. He was also very personable. I highly recommend this company.
